svg.aria-label: The packages that import pipekit-ops on their main branches: pipekit-array, pipekit-cycle, pipekit-train, pipekit-experiment, pipekit-evaluate, pipekit-jax, geotoolz-ops, xrtoolz-ops, geotoolz-array, geotoolz-patcher, gridax, diagnostix, vardax, plumax, radtrax, sesmax-core, sesmax-experiment; geotoolz-patcher through its pipekit extra and radtrax through its geo extra. pipekit-ops builds on the Python standard library alone.
svg.title: pipekit-ops and the packages that import it
